question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Have a whale of a time

options.text: A good thing that seems bad at first
Have an exceptionally fun or exciting experience

solution:
The correct answer is: **Have an exceptionally fun or exciting experience**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**Have a whale of a time**" means to have an exciting or fun time; to have a big time. (Whale is a way of saying big.) (एक रोमांचक या मजेदार समय बिताने के लिए; अच्छा समय बिताने के लिए)

 
 
• Example - *We had a whale of a time__ at Sally's birthday party.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Have a whale of a time**" is "**Have an exceptionally fun or exciting experience**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
